pm.test(autotestCaseId + " 不出现服务端未处理异常", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.below(500); });
let responseJson = null;
try { responseJson = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { responseJson = null; }

pm.test(autotestCaseId + " 无效输入被明确处理", function () { const rejectedByHttp = pm.response.code >= 400 && pm.response.code < 500; const rejectedByBusiness = responseJson && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(responseJson, "code") && ![0, 200, "0", "200"].includes(responseJson.code); pm.expect(Boolean(rejectedByHttp || rejectedByBusiness)).to.eql(true); });

pm.test(autotestCaseId + " 未返回受保护成功数据", function () { const denied = [401, 403].includes(pm.response.code) || (responseJson && ![0, 200, "0", "200"].includes(responseJson.code)); pm.expect(Boolean(denied)).to.eql(true); });
